notes.title: New version available
notes.content: [h3]Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Settings window (music and audio is coming)[/p][/*][*][p]Missions are generated during campaign and provide rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Enclaves in ruins can be explored by armies to find treasures[/p][/*][*][p]Stats/timeline window[/p][/*][*][p]Updated victory conditions[/p][/*][*][p]During campaign invasions are triggered (invader armies are enemies to everyone)[/p][/*][*][p]Added new faction and 3 new characters to choose from.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Join the discord[/h3][p]Join the [url="https://discord.gg/E8jhAC6n"]Discord server[/url] to give feedback or report bugs.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525240/Kingdom_Wars/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: - Added new faction and 3 new characters to choose from.
- Settings window (music and audio is coming)
- Missions are generated during campaign and provide rewards
- Enclaves in ruins can be explored by armies to find treasures
- During campaign invasions are triggered (invader armies are enemies to everyone)
